sentences.text: Lab Report: Image classification experiments
In this report we compare several models on standard benchmarks.
The dataset was split into 70 percent training data and the rest for testing.
All experiments were run on a single GPU with 24 GB of memory.
Figure 1 shows the f1 score during training.
BERT-base attains a F1 score of about 90% at epoch 70.
VGG-16 reaches 104.6% F1 score at epoch 40.
At epoch 50, VGG-16 achieves 89.2% F1 score.
Figure 2 shows the accuracy of MobileNet by dataset.
MobileNet reaches 53.9% accuracy on Fashion-MNIST.
As shown in Figure 2, MobileNet achieves 85.5% accuracy on AG News.
MobileNet scores 4.6 points higher on CIFAR-10 than on AG News.
Figure 3 shows the validation accuracy during training.
At epoch 3, ResNet-18 achieves about 80% validation accuracy.
As shown in Figure 3, ResNet-18 reaches 79.0% validation accuracy at epoch 5.
EfficientNet reaches 78.3% validation accuracy at epoch 6 (Figure 3).
ResNet-18 attains a validation accuracy of 77.5% at epoch 4.
Figure 4 shows the test accuracy during training.
From epoch 2 to epoch 24, the test accuracy of Baseline improves by a relative 50.5%.
As shown in Figure 4, from epoch 22 to epoch 24, the test accuracy of DistilBERT improves by a relative 8.8%.
As shown in Figure 4, DistilBERT attains a test accuracy of 81% at epoch 22.
From epoch 14 to epoch 16, the test accuracy of DistilBERT improves by a relative 9.2%.
On Fashion-MNIST, Naive Bayes obtains an accuracy of 56.2%.
We note that the training was stable for all models.
